summary: Diagnostics generation-10 validates readout identity, exact Adornee, exact text, tree shape, and cardinality, but its completeness boundary does not validate that the BillboardGui/TextLabel remains viewport-visible. A hidden/disabled/fully transparent/zero-range readout can therefore still be counted as an inspectable diagnostics projection by capture(), leaving a source/test blind spot distinct from the active non-Archivable canonical-clone finding.
evidence: Capacity review inspected current main ae83c0ef470eb2e73d99be41fd3561ede30c40e1, retained diagnostics primary PR #424 exact head f89ce88ea7791e29d22a0e2ca76b22f2d7b63699, active adversary PR #425 exact head 73a32bba954775e89bcaeaee7ec6212334688ef9, and the open diagnostics PR lineage before publishing this finding.

At #424 exact head, validateReadoutCompleteness() checks direct-child BillboardGui class, authoritative WorldEntityId membership/uniqueness, exact Adornee, one TextLabel descendant named Readout, exact label.Text, one-to-one entity count, and exact diagnostics Instance count. It does not check BillboardGui.Enabled, nonzero/effective Size or MaxDistance, nor TextLabel.Visible/TextTransparency (or an equivalent explicit visibility invariant).

The realization path sets AlwaysOnTop=true, MaxDistance=120, Size=UDim2.fromOffset(560, 116), and label Size/Text properties, but physics_lab_diagnostics_readout_contract.luau locks only identity/Adornee/text/tree/count semantics. A future visibility regression or post-enable mutation can therefore preserve every current source-contract sentinel while making the viewport projection unusable.

runToggleEvidence() treats enabled.diagnosticInstanceCount > 0 as proof that diagnostics created inspectable readouts. Because that count comes from validateReadoutCompleteness(), hidden readouts can satisfy this source-level inspectability gate even though no visible-readout property is validated there.

Docs/PHYSICS_LAB_DIAGNOSTICS.md requires diagnostics-on to visibly expose stable identity/fidelity/fingerprint/repro information and requires manual 3D-view inspection of structural and ObjectGenome-backed representations. This finding does not convert that engine requirement into source evidence; it identifies that source/tests currently do not fail closed on obvious visibility-state regressions before a real Studio run.

PR #425 is non-duplicate: it targets lab.model:Clone() omitting Archivable=false canonical live truth before strict validation. This finding concerns diagnostics-owned BillboardGui/TextLabel visibility after realization/capture completeness and requires no change to canonical clone validation.
No production code, test branch, Roblox Studio, viewport, physical-contact, or two-client execution was performed or claimed by this capacity-mining worker.

metadata.recommendedNext: After the active #425 clone-completeness work is reconciled, consider one narrow diagnostics source/test lane that makes the capture/readout completeness boundary fail closed on clearly non-visible diagnostics UI state (for example disabled BillboardGui, hidden/fully transparent TextLabel, or ineffective display range/size) without pretending source checks satisfy the required real-Studio viewport evidence. Prefer a focused expected-red regression first and do not widen canonical world validation.
